notes.title: Version 0.7.1
notes.notes:
New

 Added new puzzles.
 Added new puzzle triggers.
 Added new functionality to puzzle obstacles.
 Added a "Movement Mode" setting.
 Added camera controls for gamepads.


Changed

 Changed the look of puzzle goals.
 Updated the engine to Godot 4.3.


Fixed

 Fixed various bugs.

notes.title: Version 0.7.0
notes.notes:
Changes

 Added a new "Puzzle Halma" game mode. In this mode the goal is to move all pieces to the goal tiles within a set number of moves. There are multiple levels of increasing difficulty.

notes.title: Version 0.6.1
notes.notes:
Changes

Improved computer/AI movement.


Fixes

Fixed an issue with the "Swap Pieces" power-up.
